after.keepWhat: The source stays exactly as it is, so the move is a copy.
after.pauseWhat: A SnoutData Cloud project stops once the copy is verified, and wakes when something connects.
after.deleteWhat: Only after every object restored and every row count matched, and only once you type its name.

whyProd: The target is a production database.

title: Move a database
intro: Copy a whole Postgres database from one place to another: a SnoutData Cloud project onto this computer, or a database on this computer into the cloud. Nothing is written until you start it on the last step.
newOnServer: New database on the server of {label}
createdInRegion: Created in {region} when the move starts.
createdOnServer: Created on that server when the move starts.
onlyCloudPause: Only a SnoutData Cloud project can be paused or deleted after a move
clear: Nothing stands in the way. Review what will happen next.
decidedAll: Everything that needed a decision has one.
cardsExplain: Each card says what was found. Choose how to deal with the ones that need it.
noToolsDownload: There is no download of the tools for this computer yet.
nothingYet: Nothing has run yet. This is exactly what will happen.
firstSaved: a copy of what is in the target now is saved as a cloud export, and the move does not start if that copy fails.
droppedBefore: Dropped from the target before the copy
nothingDropped: Nothing: the target holds none of what the move writes.

backupBefore: The copy of the target saved before replacing it can be

copy.files: Every bucket and the files in it.
copy.functions: The functions folder, deployed to the cloud project.

copy.noLocal: There is no local project yet.
